text: 【南开大学田利辉：优化逆周期调节机制 提升资本市场内在稳定性】7月30日召开的中央政治局会议强调，深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。在田利辉看来，后续举措可以聚焦三方面：通过优化逆周期调节机制、完善交易制度、强化风险隔离，提升市场内在稳定性；重点推动中长期资金入市比例提升，以“分红+回购”替代短期博弈，切实增强投资者获得感；严打市场操纵、财务造假与“绕道减持”。
text_en: [Nankai University Tian Lihui: Optimize counter-cyclical adjustment mechanisms to enhance capital market stability] The July 30 Politburo meeting stressed deepening comprehensive reforms in capital market investment and financing to improve resilience and confidence. Tian Lihui sees follow-up measures focusing on three areas: enhancing internal stability via optimizing counter-cyclical mechanisms, improving trading rules, and strengthening risk isolation; boosting the proportion of long-term funds entering the market, using 'dividends + buybacks' to replace short-term speculation, and enhancing investor returns; and cracking down on market manipulation, financial fraud, and 'circuitous shareholding reductions.'
